title: Telemetry lane filled at the 1,000 cap on 9 Nov 00:43 UTC and refused events until the drain of 13 Nov 06:29 (about 4 days of reader events lost); the scheduled wakes did not fire from 5 to 12 Nov
note: Found 13 Nov 2026 at the editor's request to drain. The task trig_01TRnj8889tqPxXLhNYXRomr is enabled; its last firing before this was 4 Nov 20:33 UTC, none of the next 24 wakes fired (the session was idle or suspended). The vault holds events up to 9 Nov 00:43 UTC and nothing from then to 13 Nov 06:29; the readers' per-day numbers for 9 to 12 Nov are therefore missing, not zero. Drained 1,000 events at 13 Nov, intake open again. Needs a way to keep the session alive or to alert when a wake has not fired (the editor's choice); what a person can do meanwhile is ask for a drain. Update 13 Nov 08:34 UTC: the 08:33 wake fired on time and drained 4 events, so intake is open and the schedule is firing again; the cause of the 5 to 12 Nov gap is still unknown. The account's task list (13 Nov): only the observability task is enabled; the other 14 are disabled, and the desk, journalist, conductor and observability tasks were all touched at 06:28 UTC on 13 Nov. Not changed by observability; for the conductor and the editor.
